THE COMPANIES ACT, 2017 (XIX of 2017)
(COMPANY LIMITED BY SHARES)

Articles of Association

of
DYNAMIC ZAMEEN SOLUTIONS (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED

THE COMPANIES ACT, 2017 (XIX of 2017)
(Company Limited by Shares)
ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION
OF
DYNAMIC ZAMEEN SOLUTIONS (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED
1. The Regulations as set out in part 11 of Table ‘A’ of First Schedule to the Companies Act,
2017 (the “Act”) shall be the regulations of DYNAMIC ZAMEEN SOLUTIONS (SMCPRIVATE) LIMITED (the “Company”).
SINGLE MEMBER COMPANY
2. The Company is a “Single Member Company” and as such being a private company limited
by shares:
a) It shall not invite the public to subscribe for any shares of the Company.
b) The Company shall not register any share(s) in the name of two or more persons to
hold one or more shares jointly; and
c) Number of the members of the Company shall be limited to one.
d) The number of the members of the Company (exclusive of persons in the
employment of the Company), shall not be limited, provided that for the purpose
of this provision. Where two or more persons hold one or more shares in the
company jointly, they shall be treated as a single member, and
SHARES
3. The Company may alter its share capital in accordance with section 85 of the Act.
4. Share certificate shall be issued under the seal of the Company and shall be signed by the
member director or the non-member director, as the case may be.
DIRECTORS
5. The Company shall always have the sole member or in case it is not a natural person its
nominee, as a director but it may have such number of other director(s) who fulfil the
conditions as specified in section 153 of the Act. Following are nominee directors
nominated by the sole member of the Company:
